### d) PCoA plot of beta-diversity {.tabset}

Beta-diversity allows for comparisons between samples. The ordination plots were built by PCoA plots with JSD, Jaccard, and Bray distance matrices. Unadjusted and adjusted p-values, as well as significance, were provided by PERMANOVA test for the three methods in the separated table.


```{r Go_bdiv, include=FALSE}
  convert_and_include_pdf <- function(tool, index, subgroup = NULL, wd, bdiv) {
    metric <- sub("^ordi\\.PCoA\\.", "", tool)
    metric_pattern <- sprintf("(^|\\+)%s($|\\+)", metric)
    pattern <- sprintf(
      "^ordi\\.PCoA\\.([^.]*%s[^.]*)\\..*\\(%s\\)%s.*\\.pdf$",
      metric_pattern,
      bdiv[index],
      ifelse(is.null(subgroup), "", paste0(".*", subgroup))
    )
    input_pdf <- list.files(path = wd, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if(length(input_pdf) == 0) {
      return(invisible(NULL)) 
    }
    
    if (length(input_pdf) > 1) {
    
      message("Multiple PDF files matched pattern: ", pattern, " - using the first: ", basename(input_pdf[1]))
    
    }
    
    base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_pdf[1]))
    output_png <- file.path(dirname(input_pdf[1]), paste0(base_name, ".png"))
    
    image_read_pdf(input_pdf[1], pages = 1) %>%
      image_convert(format = "png") %>%
      image_write(output_png)
    
    include_graphics(output_png)
  }
subgroup=NULL
```


```{r conditional-title_bdiv1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if(!is.na(imgInfo$bdivplot[1])) {
  cat("#### ", imgInfo$bdivplot[1], "\n", sep="")
}
```

```{r ordi1, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3.5,  out.width='100%', eval=!is.na(imgInfo$bdivplot[1])}

convert_and_include_pdf("ordi.PCoA.bray",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$bdivplot)
convert_and_include_pdf("ordi.PCoA.unifrac",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$bdivplot)
convert_and_include_pdf("ordi.PCoA.wunifrac",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$bdivplot)


convert_and_include_pdf("ordi.PCoA.jsd",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$bdivplot)
convert_and_include_pdf("ordi.PCoA.jaccard",1, subgroup, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$bdivplot)
```
